texts.preamble: Ritesh Jain vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 23 August, 2022
texts.arguments: It is the submission of learned counsel for the petitioner that trial Court as well as appellate Court erred in convicting and awarding the jail sentence of six months of simple imprisonment with fine of Rs. 1000/- with default stipulation. In fact, petitioner is well within his HIGH COURT OF MADHYA PRADESH Criminal Revision No.3021/2022 (Ritesh Jain Vs. The State of Madhya Pradesh) limit when he sold tea in open manner rather than misrepresenting any brand for the same, court below erred in convicting the petitioner as per the Rule 32 of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Rules,1955. Petitioner already suffered 18 days' incarceration and is diabetic and heart patient.
